title: Video Downloader
summary: Fast, private video downloads, anytime, anywhere.
description:
Download Videos Easily and Quickly with Video Downloader!

Searching for a fast and reliable way to download videos? Look no further! Video Downloader lets you save videos from nearly any website for offline viewing, eliminating buffering and lag. Enjoy your favorite content anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection.

Key Features for Seamless Video Downloading:

* Lightning-Fast Downloads: Experience blazing-fast video downloads with our multi-connection download manager. Download videos several times faster than with other applications.
* Live Stream support - Download live video streams and cameras
* Built-in Private Browser: Browse with confidence using our integrated private browser with incognito mode and PIN protection. Keep your browsing history and downloaded videos private.
* Powerful Ad Blocking: Enjoy an uninterrupted viewing experience with our fully featured ad blocker. Use your own filter lists for customized ad blocking.
* Multiple SD Card Support:  Manage your downloaded videos efficiently with support for multiple SD cards.

How to Download Your Videos:

1. Enter the website URL in our built-in browser.
2. Select the desired video quality in the player.
3. Tap "Play" and wait for the video to start (skip any ads).
4. Tap the download button that appears.

More Convenient Features:

* Bookmark Your Favorite Sites: Save your frequently visited websites for quick access.
* Bookmark Import/Export: Easily transfer your bookmarks to other devices.
* Background Downloading: Download videos in the background while using other apps.
* Simultaneous Downloads: Download multiple files at the same time.
* Download Management: Pause, resume, and remove downloads with ease.
* Resume Failed Downloads:  Pick up interrupted downloads right where they left off.
* Large File Support: Download files larger than 4GB.

Important Legal Notice: This application should only be used to download videos when you have the website owner's permission or when your local intellectual property laws allow for personal use downloads.  The user is solely responsible for any illegal actions performed with this application.
